reviewer: combined complete non-author reading records, preserving contributor findings
method: Every listed article was actually read against current Chinese by someone other than its author. Writers self-read their own complete drafts; source-unit counts, coverage and word counts are supplementary, not prose-quality evidence. The lead editor adjudicated findings and applied exact local corrections. For Spanish, authorship changes by article; no self-review is passed off as independent review.
